profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer | React.js, Node.js, Python | REST APIs | SQL/MongoDB | AWS | Agile | Scalable Web Apps
profile.summary:
Multilingual Full Stack Software Engineer who recently graduated from Tripleten Software Engineering bootcamp, specialized in the development of software, with experience in both frontend (using React, Javascript, CSS, HTML) and backend (using NodeJS,
Python, MySQL, MongoDB). Graduated of Architecture and Urbanism who holds the professional title of Architect from the Universidad de Oriente in Cuba. I also worked as a junior architect in the United States for a year(2023-2024).

I'm passionate about writing clean, efficient code and continuously exploring modern tools to deliver impactful software solutions. Let’s connect if you're looking for a developer who can bridge front-end finesse with back-end power.

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
• Design and develop 5+ responsive websites using JavaScript and React, improving user experience and site interaction. 
• Research and implement best practices, enhancing overall site design and functionality for clients

positions.title: Second Slitter
positions.description:
• Set up, run, and maintain slitting machines that cut large rolls of materials like metal, paper, or plastic into smaller, specified widths. Also, transport plastic material using a forklift.
• Accurately record production data, quality checks, and other information related to the work order. 
• Monitor the entire slitting process to ensure the product meets customer quality standards. This includes checking for defects like burrs, camber, or surface imperfections.

company.name: Gunze Plastics & Engineering Corporation of America

positions.title: Junior Architect
positions.description:
• Collaborated with a team of 8 architects on the remodeling of 10+ existing residential properties. 
• Digitally represented architectural plans using AutoCAD and Revit, streamlining communication and project management. 
• Led a team of 3 in measuring and documenting property details, ensuring accurate data for digital modeling.

positions.title: Server
positions.description:
• Provided excellent customer service, maintaining a clean and safe environment.
 • Managed food and inventory, ensuring food quality, and handling payments.
